description: Low-poly voxel model of the NA62 detector at CERN on an exhibit plinth, laid out in beam order: the KTAG kaon tagger and Gigatracker plates feed a long green decay vacuum tank lined with amber LAV veto rings and four gold STRAW tracking chambers straddling the dark MNP33 dipole magnet, followed by the long stepped RICH cylinder, the CHOD disk, the fat blue octagonal LKr calorimeter, and the MUV muon-veto slabs behind their iron wall. A glowing signature kaon and cyan hit markers trace the particle path; stations slide apart along the beam axis in a disassembly animation.

interactiveDescriptions.INT_detector_beam_pipe: Segmented beam pipe carrying the kaon beam through the detector.
interactiveDescriptions.INT_detector_tracker: STRAW chambers: gold straw tubes track the decay products around the MNP33 magnet.
interactiveDescriptions.INT_detector_photon: LKr liquid-krypton calorimeter measuring photon and electron energy.
interactiveDescriptions.INT_detector_signature_particle: The signature kaon entering the detector; starts the journey.
